terms.comment: Said as the dish goes into the oven.

phrases.latin: Utramque in furnum mīsērunt. «Bonum sit!» inquit pater.
phrases.english: They put both in the oven. “May it turn out well!” said Dad.
Will that day ever come? (for waiting at the oven)
